title: COMPASS: Cross-modal Observation with Multi-Path Adaptive Stopping and Selection for Early Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early time-series classification (ETSC) balances predictive performance against the amount of observed data. In multimodal settings, modality-associated and fused branches may differ in predictive ability at the same observed prefix, motivating joint decisions about when to stop and which branch should provide the final prediction. We propose COMPASS, a two-stage framework that preserves two modality-associated temporal branches and one fusion branch. The first stage combines cross-modal feature exchange and gated fusion with branch-wise supervision at every prefix. The second stage optimizes a shared four-action controller to continue observation or terminate through one of the frozen branches. Experiments on six physiological and wearable datasets compare COMPASS with multimodal adaptations of five ETSC baselines. COMPASS achieves the best average ranks in accuracy-earliness harmonic mean, AUROC, and earliness within this comparison se

translated_title: COMPASS：用于早期时间序列分类的跨模态观测与多路径自适应停止与选择方法
translated_abstract: 早期时间序列分类（ETSC）需要在预测性能与观测数据量之间进行权衡。在多模态场景下，与各模态关联的分支和融合分支在相同观测前缀下的预测能力可能存在差异，因此需要联合决策何时停止观测以及由哪个分支给出最终预测。我们提出了COMPASS，这是一个两阶段框架，保留两个与模态关联的时间序列分支和一个融合分支。第一阶段结合跨模态特征交换、门控融合以及在每个前缀处的分支监督。第二阶段优化一个共享的四动作控制器，用于继续观测或通过某个冻结分支终止并输出预测。在六个生理与可穿戴数据集上的实验中，COMPASS与五个ETSC基线的多模态适配版本进行了比较。在该比较范围内，COMPASS在准确率-提前量调和平均值、AUROC和提前量方面均取得了最佳的平均排名。
tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架COMPASS，通过跨模态特征交换、门控融合和共享四动作控制器，在多模态早期时间序列分类中联合决策停止时机与预测分支选择，在准确率与提前量的权衡上优于现有基线。
en_tdlr: COMPASS is a two-stage framework for multimodal early time series classification that jointly decides when to stop observation and which branch to use for prediction, achieving the best accuracy-earliness trade-offs over existing baselines.
